missingAndErrorClassification.scope: No explicit catch/error/truncation record is retained. Complete raw pipe retention does not prove that an unobservable logger failure or unentered/unlogged route could not occur. Missing, lost, ambiguous and cross-instance traces remain unobserved; no failure is inferred from an absent record.
